lenses.name: Cyclical Income
lenses.asks: Income that survives the cycle: a covered dividend not cut in five years, with manageable debt.

rules.rule: Dividend cuts in the last N years
rules.limit: no year paid less than the year before, across the last 5 complete years

lenses.name: Forensic
lenses.asks: Are the profits real: cash behind the earnings, a safe balance sheet, and improving health checks.

lenses.name: Magic Formula RAW
lenses.asks: Cheap and good: high profit on the money invested, a low price for that profit, and a rising share.

agreement.rule: Names ordered by how many of the 2 voting lenses rated them BUY. Forensic and the price check do not vote; their doubts are shown as marks.
